title: The Pink Witch Halloween Costume
intro: The witch costume, minus the green face paint and the cape you trip over. A black velvet square neck mini does the heavy lifting, the soft pink velvet hat and pale pink lace gloves make it read as a costume, and chunky Mary Janes, a crescent shoulder bag and gold moon and star earrings finish it. It is cute, not scary, and it photographs beautifully at night. Every piece except the hat goes straight back into your closet for the holiday party season.
